source: Proposed hardware and illustrative local architecture; not a certified or deployed kit

enclosure.label: Chassis
enclosure.title: Built around the machine.
enclosure.description: A mounting chassis carries the compute, power and vehicle interfaces. A removable gasketed cover provides service access.

power.label: Power
power.title: Condition the input.
power.description: Machine power is filtered and regulated before it reaches the processor and sensor rails.

compute.label: Compute
compute.title: The policy stays onboard.
compute.description: A compact actor maps local observations to machine actions. The sensing and decision loop stays on the machine when the external link disappears.

controls.label: Vehicle I/O
controls.title: Connect to existing controls.
controls.description: A vehicle interface translates bounded policy commands into the machine's control signals, with a separate supervisory path.

lidar.label: Range sensing
lidar.title: Geometry, without GPS.
lidar.description: Range and pose inputs describe nearby surfaces and machine motion. Local estimation combines these observations before policy inference.

camera.label: Stereo vision
camera.title: Add visual context.
camera.description: A synchronised image pair supplies visual observations alongside range and motion data.

cover.label: Thermal path
cover.title: Move heat out of the stack.
cover.description: A thermal spreader links the compute module to the finned metal cover. The conduction path is visible in the exploded assembly.

signal_stages.label: Sense
signal_stages.description: Local observations enter the perception stack.

signal_stages.label: Estimate
signal_stages.description: Fuse geometry and motion into a local state estimate.

signal_stages.label: Infer
signal_stages.description: The compact actor selects a machine action onboard.

signal_stages.label: Actuate
signal_stages.description: The vehicle interface applies bounded commands.
